protocol.entryClock: Completed hourly decisions, native 15m next-open fills
protocol.trend: 48h efficiency >= 0.3, aligned EMA50/EMA200, previous close across EMA20 then reclaim; 2 ATR/24h structural stop; 3R target; 48h maximum
protocol.range: 48h efficiency <= 0.2, previous close beyond prior 48h mean +/-2.5 standard deviations then re-enters; 1.5 ATR/structural stop; frozen mean target >=1.3R; 8h maximum
protocol.alt: BNB/SOL/XRP only; BTC positive 24h return; alt 24h return >=3% and >=2% above BTC; positive 7d return; closes above previous24h high; quote volume >=1.5x previous24h mean; 2 ATR/24h structural stop; 3R target; 24h maximum
protocol.qualification: Minimum 1% stop distance; target gross move >=5 times declared round-trip costs. Rule score is fixed ordering, never a win probability.
protocol.selection: Exactly three fixed hypotheses and combined arbitration; all assets and both cost scenarios retained. One active position per asset within each scenario. No profits-based asset exclusions or parameter optimization.
protocol.arbitration: Existing trading-domain arbitrateCanonical, minimumScore0, deterministic IDs. Role ordering ALT80/TREND75/RANGE70 is fixed before results. No new live arbitrator.
protocol.evidence: Already examined DEVELOPMENT prices, fixed five-asset universe with survivorship/selection bias. Not untouched validation, portfolio/Prop results, historical news or independent venue evidence.
protocol.scope: Research feasibility. Not registered in production; live scanner admission requires successful screen followed by actual production-path parity and new evidence.

protocol.shock: BTC/ETH/SOL only. Previous hour marks a new24h low; asset previous24h <=-8% and previous6h <=-4%; current close above previous high and current return >=1%; current quote volume >=2x preceding24h mean; BTC previous6h negative. Stop below previous/current lows or2 hourly ATR20, whichever wider; target3R; maximum12h.
